rules.text: Include an MIT and/or OGL licence file
Give an email address for security bug reports (repo SECURITY.md, README, or org-level SECURITY.md)
Pin third-party actions to a full commit SHA
Set workflow permissions to the minimum needed
No risky triggers (pull_request_target, workflow_run, issue_comment…) without security review
Use OIDC, not IAM access keys, for AWS
Don't use personal access tokens in workflows
Keep dependencies and actions updated (Dependabot or equivalent)
Packages used by third parties: changelog and semantic versioning
Archived repos: README explains why and links to the successor
